title: Creative-Resonance Envelope
description: K-hole construct's structured output for design-reference resonance. Where a dig produces synthesis prose, an envelope produces queryable REASONING: WHY a creative reference grounds a chosen direction, HOW it composes with or contradicts other references, WHAT adjacent threads it extrapolates toward, and WHICH bounds it sets. Envelopes link by envelope_id into a navigable web of cited creative reasoning. NATIVE-STYLED, NOT UPSTREAM-OWNED: this schema lives in construct-k-hole (our domain). It is intentionally designed in the JSON-Schema-2020-12 convention of loa-hounfour (the Loa schema protocol library) and aligned with the WHY-envelope philosophy of construct-rooms-substrate (required WHY + cross-validation signals + three-tier required/recommended/optional fields) so that a produced envelope CAN ride as the verdict payload of a rooms-substrate construct-handoff packet (output_type: Artifact) without any change to those upstream repos. loa-hounfour and construct-rooms-substrate are REFERENCED CONVENTIONS, not dependencies — if either upstream team chooses to adopt this schema natively, the promotion path is documented in the K-hole pack docs; until then it is ours. Kaironic by design: minimal at v0.1 — fields are added when a real envelope needs them, not speculatively.

schema_version.description: Semver of the envelope schema. v0.1.0 = initial. Breaking field changes bump major; additive fields bump minor. Required tier.

envelope_id.description: Stable kebab-case slug. Other envelopes reference this id in composes_with / contradicts_with. Unique within an envelope set. Required tier.

ref.description: The reference being enveloped. Required tier.

name.description: The reference itself — a game, studio, person, technique, artifact, concept, or doctrine.

type.description: What KIND of reference. game/studio/person are source references; technique/artifact are method references; concept/doctrine are framing references.

studio.description: Optional — the studio/maker, if type is game or artifact.

url.description: Optional — canonical URL (store page, GDC talk, breakdown article).

direction.description: The direction this envelope grounds. Required tier.

name.description: The creative direction this envelope grounds (e.g., 'populated-diorama-world-feel'). Multiple envelopes share a direction name; together they ARE the grounded definition of that direction.

strength.description: How strongly this reference grounds the direction. 0 = name-dropped, no real fit. 0.4-0.6 = partial/contested. 0.85-1.0 = foundational. A reference can be on the board with LOW strength — that is signal too: it tells the agent NOT to over-weight it. The calibratable cross-validation signal (cf. construct-rooms-substrate why.confidence).

evidence.description: Concrete, checkable reasons for the strength score. Each item should be verifiable, not vibes.

why.description: The why-reasoning across three lenses. At least one lens must be populated (minProperties: 1), each >=32 chars (mirrors construct-rooms-substrate why.rationale discipline). This is the load-bearing field — the EXACT WHY that lets an agent extrapolate the direction deeper. Required tier.

philosophical.description: Why this resonates at the level of values / stance / what-the-work-is-about.

aesthetic.description: Why this resonates at the level of look / feel / sensory surface.

design.description: Why this resonates at the level of systems / mechanics / how-it-plays.

provenance.description: Where this envelope came from and whether it is ratified. Required tier.

surfaced_by.description: Where the evidence came from — a dig session id, a conversation date, a doctrine page path.

ratified_by.description: Operator handle who confirmed the resonance. Absent = candidate.

ratified_at.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the envelope was authored or ratified.

candidate.description: true = surfaced but not operator-ratified (reasoning is the agent's hypothesis). false = operator-ratified (reasoning is confirmed direction). Defaults true when absent.

composes_with.description: Other envelopes this one strengthens or combines with. This is what makes the set a WEB rather than a list. Recommended tier.

envelope_ref.description: envelope_id of the composing envelope. May reference an envelope not yet authored — a forward link marks it as worth writing.

on.description: The axis on which they compose (e.g., 'follower-NPC choreography pattern').

strength.description: How strongly they compose on that axis.

contradicts_with.description: Other envelopes this one is in tension with. Contradiction is not disqualifying — it marks a boundary the operator must consciously navigate. Functions as the counterfactual cross-validation signal (cf. construct-rooms-substrate why.alternative_verdicts). Recommended tier.

on.description: The axis of tension (e.g., 'realistic-vs-chibi proportion commitment').

bounds_set.description: What this reference, if adopted, locks in and locks out — the 'fences' set up when a direction resonates. Recommended tier.

locks_in.description: Commitments this reference makes canonical if adopted.

locks_out.description: Possibilities this reference forecloses if adopted.

extrapolates_to.description: Adjacent directions/features this envelope's reasoning points toward. An agent activating this envelope may pursue any of these as a natural extension. Optional tier.

threads_to_pull.description: Specific named threads (sub-references, GDC talks, techniques) to dig deeper on if this envelope is activated for a Room. The next dig's queries come from here. Optional tier.

tags.description: Free-form tags for cross-cutting queries (e.g., 'camera', 'chibi', 'substrate-coupling'). Optional tier.
